_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 35 recent 12h windows showing ±2+ point moves, this is a confirmed coil and the statistically honest call is HOLD — the bullish macro factors justify staying LONG but the score is not moving yet, so no directional phase transition is warranted.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst says HOLD (correct for a coil) while narrative leans bullish continuation; consensus sides with the analyst's HOLD on direction but maintains the LONG position signal
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows sustain above 90 AND btc_momentum_30d pushes above 60 with funding staying moderate (below 60), allowing score to drift up into Anxiety or Disbelief
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 80 OR btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d drops sharply below 70 with funding spiking above 70, indicating distribution and forced selling
